help.title: ### 🌸 Pollinations Plugin - Commands V6
help.alias_note: *(The alias `/poll` is supported and recommended instead of `/pollinations` !)*
help.mode_usage:
**Mode & Usage**
- **`/poll mode [mode]`**: Change mode (manual, quest, quest_only, paid).
- **`/poll usage [full]`**: Display dashboard (full = details).
- **`/poll fallback <main> [agent]`**: Configure Safety Net.
help.configuration:
**Configuration**
- **`/poll config [key] [value]`**:
   - `lang`: en, fr, etc.
   - `status_gui`: none, alert, all
   - `logs_gui`: none, error, verbose
   - `threshold_quest` / `threshold_wallet`: pollen floor (default 0.05 / 0.5)
   - `status_bar`: true/false
   - `cost_estimator`: true/false (show cost in outputs)
   - `enablePaidTools`: true/false (blocks paid_only locally — no server guarantee)
   - `costThreshold`: limit in pollen (default: 0.15)
   - `costConfirmationRequired`: true/false (spend confirmation)
help.models_pricing:
**Models & Pricing**
- **`/poll models [type]`**: List models (type: image, video, audio, text)
- **`/poll pricing`**: Detailed pricing table
- **`/poll infos`**: Explanations on Tiers and Pollen
- **`/poll quests`**: View your quests & claimable free Pollen

> 💡 **RMBG keys**: Use the `rmbg_keys` tool (works with any model).
help.connection:
**🔐 Connect your Pollinations account (recommended)**
- **`/poll login`**: One-click browser OAuth. Sign in with GitHub, approve, and the plugin connects automatically — no API key to copy/paste. This is the recommended path for account, Quest and Paid features.
- **`/poll connect sk_...`**: Manual BYOK only if you already have a Pollinations Secret key.

infos.title:
## 🍯💚 POLLINATIONS OPENCODE PLUGIN 💚🍯

Welcome **{name}** to the Pollinations OpenCode plugin!

This plugin empowers you to generate code, images, analyze videos, and interact with top-tier AI models seamlessly within your dev environment. Access state-of-the-art LLMs via chat, refactoring, or terminal.
infos.features_free:
**🛠️ Integrated Free Tools (Always Available):**
- `gen_qrcode` / `gen_diagram` / `gen_palette` : Visuals and dev utilities.
- `remove_background` : AI background removal (rmbg / bgeraser — free).
- `extract_frames` / `extract_audio` : Fast media extraction.
- `file_to_url` : Instant online hosting of local files.
- `gen_edit_image_free` : Free image gen & edit (~20/day).
- `gen_video_free` : Free video gen (~5/day).
- `object_remover` : Remove objects by prompt (free, direct).
- `image_upscaler` : Upscale 2x/4x (free, direct).
- `image_enhancer` : AI image enhancement (free, direct).
infos.features_pro:
**💎 Pollinations Tools (Premium - Automated with Key) :**
- `polli_gen_image` : Image gen (Flux, Seedream, Gemini) + Image-to-Image.
- `polli_gen_video` : Text-to-video / Image-to-video (Veo, Wan, LTX...).
- `polli_gen_audio`/`polli_stt` : Whisper STT, ElevenLabs TTS.
- `polli_gen_music` : Generative music engine.
- `polli_web_search` : Connected web search.
infos.features_config: - **Granular configuration**, mode and token management, tool cost protections...
infos.about:
## 🌍 What is pollinations.ai ?
pollinations.ai is an open-source AI platform built by and for the community. We provide a unified API for Image, Text, Audio, and Video. Everything is open: our code, roadmap, conversations. Hundreds of devs are already building apps, games, bots, and crazy experiments with us. Join us!

No black boxes. No vendor lock-in. Just a friendly API and a Discord full of helpful people.
infos.pollen_get:
Running AI models costs money. Pollen is our way to keep servers running without ads or selling data. A simple, unified credit for all models — predictable, transparent, no surprises.

**$1 ≈ 1 Pollen** (prices subject to change). You spend it on API calls.
infos.pollen_spend:
## 🛒 How to get Pollen?
1. 🎯 **Quests** — Complete tasks on the dashboard (`/poll quests`).
2. 💳 **Buy** — By credit card at enter.pollinations.ai.
3. 🌻 **Dev earnings** — Enable developer earnings on your App Key.
infos.quests:
## 🎯 Quests — Earn Free Pollen
Pollen is now mainly earned by completing **Quests**. Good news: just using this plugin (text, image & audio models) completes several quests **retroactively** — you may already have free Pollen waiting!

👉 Review & claim your rewards on the [dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai). _Claiming is dashboard-only._

> 💡 Quest Pollen works on all standard models. 💎 Paid-only models still require purchased Pollen.
infos.get_started:
## 🔐 Connect your account — recommended

**Just type `/poll login`.** Your browser opens, you sign in with GitHub and approve, and the plugin connects automatically. **No API key to create, copy or paste.**

Manual BYOK is optional and only for users who already have a Secret key: `/poll connect sk_...`.

Type `/poll help` for all commands.
infos.quest_paid_body:
Pollen is split into two columns:

- **🎁 Quest Pollen** — earned by completing **Quests** (free). Consumed first by the server.
- **💎 Paid Pollen** — purchased (credit card). Used when Quest is insufficient, or for `paid_only` models.

> ⚠️ The plugin cannot read the split server-side; it estimates Quest/Paid locally and reads the real split (`meter_source`) from `/account/usage`.

**Modes:**
- `quest` (QUEST_PREFERRED) — default: Quest first, Paid fallback allowed.
- `quest_only` (QUEST_ELIGIBLE_ONLY) — blocks paid_only models, best-effort Quest only.
- `paid` (PAID_ALLOWED) — Paid allowed.
- `manual` — no automatic policy.

login.prompt:
## 🔐 Quick Login (Device Flow)

**1.** Open: **{uri_complete}**
_(or go to {uri} and enter the code below)_

**2.** Your code: **`{code}`**

**3.** Sign in with GitHub, then on the consent form:
   • ✅ Keep **Profile** + **Usage** granted (needed for quota, quests & the free-universe fallback)
   • 💡 For an **unlimited key**: clear the **Budget** field (→ Unlimited) and the **Expiry** field (→ Never)
   • Click **Authorize**

The plugin is waiting and connects **automatically** once you approve (a toast confirms ✅).

💡 _Prefer a manually-created key? Use `/poll connect sk_...` instead._

polli_gen_audio.desc:
Convert text to speech using Pollinations AI.

**🔊 Models:**

| Model | Type | Voices | Format | Cost | Notes |
|-------|------|--------|--------|------|-------|
| openai-audio | TTS + STT | 6 | mp3, wav, pcm16 | Lowest | **DEFAULT** - GPT-4o Audio |
| elevenlabs | TTS | 34 | mp3, wav, etc. | Higher | Expressive voices |

**🎵 OpenAI Audio (Default, Recommended):**
- Voices: `alloy`, `echo`, `fable`, `onyx`, `nova`, `shimmer`
- Formats: `mp3` (default), `wav`, `pcm16`
- Uses GPT-4o Audio Preview modalities endpoint
- Lowest cost option

**🎤 ElevenLabs:**
- 34 expressive voices including: rachel, domi, bella, adam, etc.
- Higher quality natural-sounding speech
- More expensive but more expressive

**💡 Tips:**
- Use `openai-audio` for cost-effective TTS
- Use `elevenlabs` for more expressive/character voices
- For STT (transcription), use the `transcribe_audio` tool.

polli_gen_music.desc:
Generate music from a text description using Pollinations AI.

**🎵 Model:** elevenmusic (ElevenLabs Music)

**📝 Parameters:**
- `duration`: 3-300 seconds (default: 10s)
- `instrumental`: true = no vocals, false = vocals allowed

**💡 Example Prompts:**
- "upbeat jazz with saxophone solo"
- "ambient electronic for meditation"
- "epic orchestral film score"
- "lo-fi hip hop beats"

**💰 Cost:** ~0.005 🌻 per second
- 10 seconds ≈ 0.05 🌻
- 60 seconds ≈ 0.30 🌻

**⚠️ Notes:**
- Generation time scales with duration (~1s per second of audio)
- Longer tracks (60s+) may take 1-2 minutes
- Instrumental mode produces cleaner results for background music

polli_transcribe_audio.desc:
Transcribe audio to text using Pollinations AI.

**🎙️ Models:**

| Model | Supplier | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| whisper-large-v3 | OpenAI | **DEFAULT** - High accuracy, long audio |
| whisper-1 | OpenAI | Standard accuracy |
| scribe | ElevenLabs | Scribe v2 model |

**📁 Supported Formats:**
mp3, wav, m4a, webm, mp4, mpeg, mpga, ogg

**💡 Tips:**
- Use `whisper-large-v3` for the highest accuracy on long recordings
- Supports both local files and URLs

**📋 Output:**
- Returns transcribed text
- Includes detected language (if available)
- Shows processing time

polli_login.desc: 🔐 PREFERRED account connection method. When the user asks to connect/sign in to Pollinations, call this tool automatically instead of asking them to create or paste an API key. It starts the 1-click browser device OAuth: show the returned URL/code, the user signs in with GitHub and approves, then the plugin connects automatically. No API key is needed to start. Use `/poll connect sk_...` only when the user explicitly wants manual BYOK or already has a Secret key.
polli_login.arg_wait: If true, waits for an in-progress login to complete and returns the final result (✅ connected / expired). Call once without wait to show the code, then again with wait:true after telling the user to authorize.

gen3d.desc:
Generate a 3D object from a text prompt or reference image using Pollinations AI.

The current 3D models, access flags, I/O capabilities and costs are injected dynamically from the live Model Registry.

**⏱️ Long-running** : generation can take 20s–150s+ (LONG_BLOCKING). Use `timeout_seconds` to control the local wait.

**♻️ Recovery** : after a timeout, the generation may still be running and billed. Re-running with the SAME seed returns the artifact from cache (not rebilled).
gen3d.arg_prompt: Text description of the 3D object (optional when image is provided)
gen3d.arg_image: Optional reference image URL (1 image max)
gen3d.arg_seed: Seed for reproducibility and cache recovery
gen3d.arg_save_to: Custom output directory or file path
gen3d.arg_timeout: Per-call timeout in seconds (10–3600). No automatic resubmit on timeout.
gen3d.req_key: ❌ polli_gen_3d requires an API key (/poll login).\n💡 Connect with `/poll login` (recommended, 1-click OAuth). Manual BYOK: `/poll connect sk_...`.

## 🚀 Multimedia Agents and Tools for Developers

Claude Opus, GPT-5, Gemini 3, Veo & Wan Video Gen, ElevenLabs Music... unlock the full power of the Pollinations API!

This plugin uses a **BYOK** (Bring Your Own Key) model: with your own API key, the OpenCode Agent can interact directly with Premium tools, creating your media files in your Workspace.

**Step 1 — Create a free account**
👉 **https://enter.pollinations.ai**

**Step 2 — Generate your API key**
In the **API Keys** section on `enter.pollinations.ai`, create a **Secret** key (`sk_...`).

**Step 3 — Connect the key**
```bash
`/poll login` (recommended) or `/poll connect` sk_your_key_here
```
*(The key is immediately registered in your OpenCode environment, unlocking Pro models!)*

---

## 💰 Quest & Paid Pollen
**Quest Pollen** is earned free by completing **Quests** — simply using this plugin completes several of them retroactively! Check `/poll quests`.

When Quest pollen is insufficient (or for paid-only models), **Paid Pollen** (purchased) is used. The plugin estimates both locally and reads the real split (`meter_source`) from `/account/usage`.

**Need help?** Type `/poll help`. Official Discord: https://discord.gg/pollinations-ai-885844321461485618

## 🌸 Welcome to the Pollinations Plugin

**Immediate free access — no key required**
This plugin provides a complete environment for chat, code generation, and media tools. Select a `pollinations/free/*` model and start immediately.

**🆓 Bonus free tools (no key needed):** `gen_edit_image_free`, `gen_video_free`, `object_remover`, `image_upscaler`, `image_enhancer`, `remove_background`.

## 🔐 Connect in one click — recommended
To unlock your Pollinations account, Quests, wallet, premium models and paid tools, simply run:

```bash
/poll login
```

Your browser opens. Sign in with GitHub, approve the authorization, and the plugin connects automatically. **No API key to create, copy or paste.**

Already have a Pollinations Secret key? Manual BYOK remains available:
```bash
/poll connect sk_your_key_here
```

---

## 💰 Quest & Paid Pollen
Quest Pollen is earned by completing Quests. When Quest Pollen is insufficient (or for paid-only models), Paid Pollen is used. Check `/poll quests` and `/poll usage full`.

**Need help?** Type `/poll help`. Official Discord: https://discord.gg/pollinations-ai-885844321461485618
